name: Job Search
tagline: Closed-source job board aggregator: 5 APIs, ~16.5k jobs, medallion pipeline
description: A scheduled pipeline that pulls remote jobs from five free job-board APIs (Remotive, Jobicy, Himalayas, Arbeitnow, Greenhouse), normalizes them into one schema with a composite key, loads them into SQLite, and tags every row with a remote-work scope (global / multi-region / region-only). PySpark transforms the data into clean marts, and a daily analysis produces a shortlist of apply-able roles for APAC-eligible candidates.
sourceNote: Closed. Architecture and code available on request.

name: Cyclistic Bike-share Capstone
tagline: Google Data Analytics capstone: how casual riders and members use the bikes
description: Analyzed a year of Cyclistic bike-share data to understand how casual riders and annual members use the bikes differently. Cleaned the data in Excel and Power Query, then built the analysis and visualizations in Power BI to recommend how marketing could convert casual riders into members.
sourceNote: Part of the Google Data Analytics Certificate. Full write-up with charts on Medium.
